direction_notes: Transient HbO increase and RHb decrease during 8 MHz tFUS of somatosensory cortex but not sham; amplitude increased with intensity.
safety_notes: Mice observed for 24 h after the experiment with no apparent behavioural change; temperature rise estimated below 0.01 C.

exposures.label: 8 MHz tFUS of somatosensory cortex, two intensities

timing.protocol_description: Each trial: 5 s stimulation of ten pulse trains at 2 Hz, each train of 300 pulses of 500 cycles at 8 MHz with PRF 1500 Hz; trial 17 s, one trial per minute, 25 trials per condition (two intensities plus sham), randomly shuffled.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Cerebral hemodynamic changes were calculated from the NIRS signals obtained from 10 mice using the modified Beer–Lambert Law [16].
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: Ultrasound stimulation was achieved using a focused single element ultrasound transducer with a focal distance of 19 mm, and 8 MHz fundamental frequency.
source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.ispta_w_cm2: The stimulation paradigms were selected in a way to keep the same pulse repetition frequency (PRF) of 1500  Hz and duty cycle of 9% but with diferent acoustic intensities (as measured in water, $\mathrm { I } _ { \mathrm { S P T A } } )$ of 1077 and 468 mW/ $\mathrm { c m } ^ { 2 } .$ .
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.ispta_w_cm2: After passing through the skull, the acoustic intensities of the stimulation $( \mathrm { I } _ { \mathrm { S P T A } } = 1 2 9$ and 56 $\mathrm { m W } / \mathrm { c m } ^ { 2 } )$ were also lower than the guidelines for ultrasound imaging $( \mathrm { I } _ { \mathrm { S P T A } } { = } 7 2 0 \ \mathrm { m W } / \mathrm { c m } ^ { 2 } )$ .

source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: Each acquisition trial lasts for a total of 17  s including 5  s of stimulation containing ten ultrasound pulse trains with a repetition rate of 2  Hz.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: All animals received three diferent stimulation conditions, including sham, within a single acquisition experiment.
